title: Corrigendum to “Market-based short-rate uncertainty and time-varying expected returns” [Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control 188 (2026) 105348]
title_zh: 对《基于市场的短期利率不确定性与时变预期收益》的勘误 [Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control 188 (2026) 105348]

abstract: This paper develops a multi-sector growth model to analyse the general equilibrium effects of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on growth, structural transformation and international trade. It introduces a crucial distinction between high-skill, high-income, highly digitalized, tradable services and low-skill, less digitalized, less-tradable services, allowing GenAI to differentially affect sectors through both supply-side productivity gains and demand-side shifts in consumer preferences. The model generates testable implications consistent with emerging empirical evidence and delivers several novel predictions. Unless GenAI adoption is broad-based and accompanied by the creation of new products that shift demand toward skill-intensive activities, its aggregate growth effects are likely to be modest. The paper highlights the risk of ‘premature de-professionalization’—a contraction in the capacity of economies, particularly developing ones, to generate well-paid jobs in high-skill services. This process is primarily driven by domestic general equilibrium forces, as productivity gains in high-skill sectors may outpace demand expansion and reduce labour absorption. International trade plays a critical amplifying role in shaping both the timing and severity of this process: falling global relative prices of high-skill tradable services, combined with delayed AI adoption, can erode comparative advantage and lock countries into low-skill, low-income specializations. In this respect, premature de-professionalization parallels the well-documented phenomenon of premature de-industrialization, but operates through high-skill services rather than manufacturing—potentially narrowing development pathways at earlier stages of income.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个多部门增长模型，用以分析生成式人工智能（GenAI）对经济增长、结构转型及国际贸易的总体均衡效应。模型引入了高技能、高收入、高度数字化且可贸易的服务业与低技能、数字化程度较低且可贸易性较弱的服务业之间的关键区分，从而使GenAI能够通过供给侧生产率提升和需求侧消费者偏好转变，对各部门产生差异化影响。该模型得出的可检验推论与新兴经验证据相符，并提出了若干新颖预测。除非GenAI的采用具有广泛基础，并伴随新产品创造以将需求转向技能密集型活动，否则其总体增长效应可能较为有限。本文强调了“过早去职业化”的风险——即经济体（尤其是发展中经济体）在高技能服务业中创造高薪岗位能力的收缩。这一过程主要由国内总体均衡力量驱动，因为高技能部门的生产率提升可能超过需求扩张，从而减少劳动力吸纳。国际贸易在塑造这一过程的时间与严重程度方面发挥着关键的放大作用：全球高技能可贸易服务相对价格下降，加之AI采用滞后，可能侵蚀比较优势，并将国家锁定在低技能、低收入的专业化分工中。就此而言，过早去职业化与广为人知的过早去工业化现象相似，但其作用渠道是高技能服务业而非制造业——这可能在更早的收入阶段就收窄了发展路径。
title: Generative AI: Catalyst for Growth or Harbinger of Premature De‐Professionalization?
title_zh: 生成式人工智能：增长催化剂还是过早去职业化的预兆？

abstract: This study examines the main drivers influencing the adoption of two types of precision farming technologies in the viticultural sector: Decision Support Systems (DSSs) and Variable Rate Technologies (VRTs). We apply a partial proportional odds model and find that socio‐demographic characteristics are not significant determinants of adoption, whereas farm structural features and a general positive attitude toward technology significantly increase the likelihood of uptake. Environmental concern plays a role only with respect to the intention to adopt, but not in explaining actual adoption behavior. Moreover, farmers' perceptions of the usefulness of digital technologies and the difficulties associated with their use emerge as key factors shaping adoption intentions among non‐adopters. These results suggest that targeted training initiatives and strengthened advisory services could play a crucial role in fostering the diffusion of precision farming technologies in viticulture.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了影响葡萄种植业采纳两类精准农业技术的主要驱动因素：决策支持系统（DSSs）与变量施肥技术（VRTs）。通过应用部分比例优势模型，本研究发现社会人口特征并非技术采纳的显著决定因素，而农场结构特征及对技术的普遍积极态度则显著提升了采纳概率。环境关注仅在采纳意愿层面发挥作用，但无法解释实际采纳行为。此外，农户对数字技术实用性的认知及使用困难程度，成为影响非采纳者采纳意愿的关键因素。这些结果表明，针对性的培训计划与强化咨询服务可在促进葡萄种植业精准农业技术推广中发挥关键作用。
title: Drivers of Precision Agriculture Adoption in Italian Viticulture
title_zh: 意大利葡萄栽培中精准农业采纳的驱动因素

abstract: The United States spends billions annually on crop insurance premium subsidies, yet the prevailing distance‐based guarantee design unintentionally rewards risk‐taking by linking subsidies to yield variability. We consider a simple redesign: define guarantees in terms of probability so that coverage reflects a consistent likelihood of indemnity. Using US data, this probability‐based approach would reallocate about $3.3 billion in annual subsidies from high‐risk to low‐risk production, reducing regional disparities by two‐thirds without changing total subsidies. Because most publicly subsidized crop insurance programs around the world share this structure, adopting probability‐based guarantees could help realign agricultural production toward more resilient and sustainable regions and practices.
abstract_zh: 美国每年在农作物保险保费补贴上投入数十亿美元，然而现行基于距离的保障设计因将补贴与产量波动挂钩，无意中激励了风险承担行为。我们提出一种简单的重新设计方案：以概率定义保障，使保险覆盖范围反映一致的赔付可能性。基于美国数据的测算表明，这种概率导向方法每年可将约33亿美元补贴从高风险生产重新分配至低风险生产，在不改变补贴总额的情况下将区域差异减少三分之二。由于全球大多数公共补贴农作物保险计划均采用类似结构，采纳概率型保障有助于引导农业生产向更具韧性和可持续性的区域及实践模式转型。
title: Crop Insurance Design and On‐Farm Risk Adaptation
title_zh: 农作物保险设计与农场风险适应

abstract: Cluster farming has been promoted as an institutional strategy to improve smallholder productivity, market access and profitability in developing countries. However, empirical evidence on the association between governance practices and wheat profitability within cluster systems remains limited. This study examines the role of governance practices on the profitability of wheat farmers in Ethiopia, placing particular emphasis on the mediating role of farm‐gate selling prices. Using cross‐sectional data from 759 farmers across 11 clusters, governance dimension indices were constructed using principal component analysis, and effects were estimated using two‐stage least squares, three‐stage least squares and quantile regression. Results show that accountability, participation and conflict resolution have positive and significant effects on wheat profitability, while transparency has a negative association, likely reflecting coordination and compliance costs. Mediation analysis reveals that farm‐gate price explains about 89.5% of governance's total effect on profitability. Governance effects also vary by cluster group, landholding size, input use and profitability levels. Strong governance improves bargaining power, price realisation and economic returns. The findings highlight the importance of institutional quality in cluster farming. Strengthening accountability, participation and conflict resolution can significantly improve profitability and support smallholder livelihoods, offering key policy insights for cluster‐based agricultural development in Ethiopia and similar contexts.
abstract_zh: 集群农业已被推广为一种制度性策略，旨在提升发展中国家小农户的生产力、市场准入和盈利能力。然而，关于集群体系内治理实践与小麦盈利能力之间关联的实证证据仍然有限。本研究考察了治理实践对埃塞俄比亚小麦农户盈利能力的作用，特别关注农场交货销售价格的中介效应。利用来自11个集群759名农户的横截面数据，通过主成分分析法构建了治理维度指数，并采用两阶段最小二乘法、三阶段最小二乘法及分位数回归估计效应。结果表明，问责制、参与度和冲突解决对小麦盈利能力具有显著正向影响，而透明度则呈现负向关联，这很可能反映了协调与合规成本。中介分析显示，农场交货价格解释了治理对盈利能力总效应的约89.5%。治理效应还因集群组别、土地持有规模、投入品使用及盈利水平而异。强有力的治理能够提升议价能力、价格实现水平及经济回报。研究结果凸显了制度质量在集群农业中的重要性。加强问责制、参与度和冲突解决可显著改善盈利能力并支持小农户生计，为埃塞俄比亚及类似情境下的集群农业发展提供了关键政策启示。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Do Governance Practices in Cluster Farming Improve Wheat Farmers' Profitability? Evidence From Ethiopia
title_zh: 集群农业中的治理实践是否提高了小麦农户的盈利能力？来自埃塞俄比亚的证据

abstract: We develop a framework for regulated production systems where output generation and pollution abatement impose competing technological demands. Using a multi‐ware technology, we model the production set as the intersection of two input requirement frontiers, one for production and one for abatement, each reflecting distinct trade‐offs. We characterise the efficient set using gaps in efficiency distances and recover shadow prices for smooth and non‐smooth frontiers, clarifying how subdifferentials govern shadow prices at switching points. To address unobserved heterogeneity in technological orientation, we estimate a full‐information maximum likelihood model with endogenous regime‐switching. Applying the framework to Chinese livestock farms, we recover regime‐specific land costs, identify drivers of regime assignment and quantify inefficiency using multi‐ware distances. Results reveal sharp asymmetries in spatial burdens between production and abatement, and systematic switching behaviour driven by inputs and weather. Our framework offers a widely applicable, policy‐relevant tool for evaluating environmental and economic performance. JEL Classification: D24, Q12, Q52
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个受监管生产系统的分析框架，其中产出生成与污染减排对技术提出竞争性要求。通过采用多仓库技术，我们将生产集建模为两个投入需求前沿的交集——一个针对生产，另一个针对减排，各自反映不同的权衡关系。我们利用效率距离的缺口刻画有效集，并推导出光滑与非光滑前沿的影子价格，阐明次微分如何在切换点主导影子价格。为解决技术方向中未观测到的异质性，我们估计了一个包含内生机制切换的全信息最大似然模型。将该框架应用于中国畜牧养殖场，我们恢复了机制特定的土地成本，识别了机制分配的驱动因素，并利用多仓库距离量化了无效率。研究结果揭示了生产与减排之间空间负担的显著不对称性，以及由投入和天气驱动的系统性切换行为。我们的框架为评估环境与经济绩效提供了一个广泛适用且具有政策相关性的工具。JEL分类：D24, Q12, Q52

title: Efficiency, Shadow Pricing and Regime Switching in Multi‐Ware Technologies: Evidence From Regulated Livestock Farms
title_zh: 多仓库技术中的效率、影子定价与制度转换：来自受监管畜牧场的证据

abstract: Limited liability company legislation was introduced to the Cape Colony in 1861. An amendment in 1892 led to wider adoption, expanding and diversifying the capital market. Using novel data from the Cape Joint Stock Archive between 1892 and 1902, this paper examines who invested, where capital flowed, and how these patterns shaped firm outcomes across Southern Africa. We show the geographic breadth of the capital market, revealing how shareholders and company operations were dispersed far beyond the Cape. The depth measures shareholders' occupational diversity using Historical International Standard Classifications of Occupations (HISCO) and paid‐up capital. We find investor participation varied systematically by occupation, industry, and location. These preferences influenced firm survival and spatial organization. Shareholders invested at considerable distances from company operations or registered offices, facilitating early forms of managerial separation. Paid‐up capital, a proxy for shareholder depth, was associated with survival, with smaller firms exhibiting shorter lifespans. Formation and failure were closely tied to both local and external economic shocks, underscoring the integration of the Cape economy into wider business cycles. Finally, the Cape illustrates how early commercial law and the organization of private capital may have shaped longer‐run regional economic structures.
abstract_zh: 1861年，开普殖民地引入了有限责任公司立法。1892年的一项修正案推动了该制度的更广泛采用，从而扩大并丰富了资本市场。本文利用1892年至1902年间开普联合股票档案的新数据，考察了谁在投资、资本流向何处，以及这些模式如何影响南部非洲企业的经营成果。我们展示了资本市场的地理广度，揭示了股东和公司运营如何远远超出开普地区。通过历史国际标准职业分类（HISCO）和实缴资本，我们衡量了股东职业多样性的深度。研究发现，投资者的参与因职业、行业和地理位置而呈现系统性差异。这些偏好影响了企业的生存和空间组织。股东在距离公司运营或注册办事处相当远的地方进行投资，促进了早期形式的管理分离。实缴资本作为股东深度的代理变量，与企业的生存相关，规模较小的公司寿命较短。企业的成立与倒闭与本地及外部经济冲击密切相关，凸显了开普经济与更广泛商业周期的融合。最后，开普的案例表明，早期商业法和私人资本的组织方式可能塑造了长期区域经济结构。
title: The depth and breadth of capitalism at the Cape
title_zh: 开普地区资本主义的深度与广度

abstract: In this paper, we investigate the contracts offered by a large healthcare purchaser to health service providers. Contracts are based on the DRG principle that all hospitalizations in a diagnosis group are reimbursed at the same rate. This principle is relaxed in practice, as in several cases, the amount reimbursed within each DRG exhibits considerable variability. We build a theoretical model which explains this variability as the attempt of the health authority to ensure appropriate matching between hospitals and patients. We test the model using a very large and detailed administrative data set for the largest region in Italy. In line with our theoretical results, we show that the state funded purchaser offers providers a system of incentives such that, as required by optimality, that providers which treat more patients receive a higher average reimbursement per treatment, suggesting therefore that they treat on average more difficult patients and are compensated for doing so.
abstract_zh: 本文研究大型医疗采购方向医疗服务提供者提供的合同。合同基于诊断相关分组（DRG）原则，即同一诊断组内的所有住院治疗均按相同费率报销。然而在实践中，这一原则有所放宽——在多个案例中，每个DRG内的报销金额呈现出显著差异。我们构建了一个理论模型，将这种差异解释为卫生当局为确保医院与患者之间实现恰当匹配的尝试。我们利用意大利最大地区极为详尽的管理数据集对模型进行检验。与理论结果一致，我们发现，国家资助的采购方向提供者提供了一套激励机制：根据最优性要求，治疗患者数量越多的提供者，其每次治疗的平均报销金额越高，这表明他们平均治疗了病情更复杂的患者，并因此获得相应补偿。
title: Optimal Healthcare Contracts: Theory and Empirical Evidence
title_zh: 最优医疗合同：理论与实证证据

abstract: This paper studies whether the world’s largest workfare scheme reduces targeted violence against marginalized groups. Leveraging the district-wise phased rollout of the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS), we employ a difference-in-differences design to identify the causal impact of MGNREGS implementation on targeted crimes against disadvantaged caste groups. Our findings show a significant increase in reported caste-based crimes following the scheme’s introduction. We discuss and provide suggestive evidence on the mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球规模最大的工作福利计划是否减少了针对边缘化群体的定向暴力。利用圣雄甘地国家农村就业保障计划（MGNREGS）在各地区的分阶段推广，我们采用双重差分设计来识别MGNREGS实施对针对弱势种姓群体的定向犯罪的影响。研究结果显示，该计划引入后，报告的基于种姓的犯罪显著增加。我们讨论了相关机制并提供了初步证据。
title: Can public works increase caste-based conflicts? Evidence from India’s National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
title_zh: 公共工程会加剧种姓冲突吗？来自印度全国农村就业保障计划的证据
